title: JWT (JSON Web Tokens)
simpleMetaphor: A secure digital badge that proves your user identity across API requests.
technicalExplanation: Compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties statelessly.

title: OAuth 2.0
simpleMetaphor: 'Log in with Google/GitHub' button protocol without sharing your actual password.
technicalExplanation: Industry-standard authorization framework enabling secure third-party delegated access.

title: Auth0
simpleMetaphor: Enterprise identity platform handling logins, multi-factor auth, and user security.
technicalExplanation: Flexible cloud identity solution providing authentication and authorization as a service.

title: Clerk
simpleMetaphor: Pre-built, beautiful authentication components for React and Next.js.
technicalExplanation: Complete user management and authentication suite with drop-in React components.

title: NextAuth / Auth.js
simpleMetaphor: The open-source authentication library built specifically for Next.js applications.
technicalExplanation: Flexible open-source authentication library supporting OAuth providers, JWTs, and database adapters.

title: CORS
simpleMetaphor: Browser security rule that decides which websites are allowed to request data from your API.
technicalExplanation: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing HTTP-header based mechanism allowing restricted resource sharing.

title: HTTPS / SSL
simpleMetaphor: Encrypts web traffic between browser and server so eavesdroppers cannot read it.
technicalExplanation: Transport Layer Security (TLS/SSL) protocol ensuring encrypted HTTP communication.

title: Rate Limiting
simpleMetaphor: Prevents bots from spamming your API by limiting requests per minute.
technicalExplanation: Security technique used to control incoming network traffic rates and prevent DDoS attacks.
